{{Top}}
An '''author''' was someone who wrote literature. Depending on the specific type of literature, authors were called by various other names including '''dramatists''', '''writers''', '''playwrights''', or [[Poet/Legends|poets]].

==Dramatist and playwrights==
[[Lyechusas]] was the most renowned dramatist of the [[Lisst'n]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and was notable for penning three trilogies on the life of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]].<ref name="XimII">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek03/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part II: The Pirate Prince)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref> [[Hako Armado]] was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] dramatist during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="H&R">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>
